budget_basis: ZERO SPENT, and the plan cells exist only because the metering runs on the FAKE transport too. 2 cells x 4 rows = 8 requests built, doubled to 16 so the check can be re-run once inside one run id; 2 x 15.011 = 30.1 audio seconds accounted, ceiling 120; 0.1 GPU hours nominal. NOTHING IS ACTUALLY SPENT: the transport is core.flight.runtime.WireCheckTransport, which never opens a socket, and the realized frozen-core contacts are 0. The two REGISTERED KU-S4N flights do not share this run id -- each has its own experiment fragment, its own plan, its own exposure row and its own single recovery allowance.
comparator: None. This fragment makes no contrast; the KU-S4N comparators are named in each cell's own registered experiment fragment.
decision_rule: There is none: a wire check has no decision. It passes or it refuses, and the refusal is the finding.
gate: PASS requires, for EACH of the two cells: 4 of 4 requests built and 0 model contacts; policy phase-direct-only-supplied-v1 with contacts_per_sample 1; a phase_supply receipt covering exactly the 'direct' phase; typed_knowledge_blocks equal, per row, to that row's own candidate count and to the supplied-evidence count on its payload; every supplied evidence id carrying the candidate value prefix; exactly one CONTROL history turn per request and one control turn shared by all four rows and by both cells; the resolved system message byte-identical to the sealed closed-list comparator's 4073f79e...0d37db; distinct config and protocol hashes for the arm and its twin; a twin sharing no candidate with the arm on any row; and rails.runner's own containment fold raising on none of them. The multipacket half additionally requires the real core.policies.build_arm_payload to accept one query plus eight keys and to refuse two queries, zero queries and an unknown role.
never_fly_this_fragment: THIS FRAGMENT IS FOR --wire-check AND --dry-run ONLY. It has no exposure-ledger row of its own beyond the model-free preparation row and must never be run with --run: a real transport under it would spend contacts nothing has registered. The two registered KU-S4N experiment fragments are the ones that fly.
population: Four rows of the frozen DEV-1000 runtime view, named in the populations block below, contacted zero times.

populations.basis: The SAME four rows the sealed closed-list wiring proof, the MF-5 SLURP phase smoke, the KC-S1 smoke and the KV wire check all used: the first four DEV-1000 sample ids in sorted order. Named HERE, in the registered fragment, rather than on a command line, so a check can never quietly touch four different rows than the ones its row names. No contact is made against them here.

purpose: FOUR-ROW REQUEST-HALF WIRE CHECK of the KU-S4N arm and its twin, before either is registered to fly, plus the multi-packet composition proof KU-S4a/b need. Zero model contacts and zero sockets: core.flight.runtime.WireCheckGate and WireCheckTransport stand in for the gate and the transport, and everything between them is real -- the real core.config.compose, the real roster with every media file re-hashed, the real candidate-snapshot load and content-hash verification, the real sha256-verified candidate bank, the real phase program, the real phase_supply bootstrap seeding, the real phase_review judge, the real containment fold on every contact instruction, and the real request build through the payload-binding stage.
what_is_not_read: No wire-check output is a task measurement. The responses are core.flight.runtime.WireCheckTransport's canned string; no comparator, verdict or admission is touched.
